# E3 by potential (generated by experiments/make_numbers.py from results/results_relaxation.json)

Table 1 of the manuscript up to v0.4 (five datasets per potential). "Reaching E*" means within 1e-06 relative of the best energy found by any method. "Lloyd f.p. 1-move stable": Lloyd fixed points that no single move improves (all relaxation fixed points are Lloyd fixed points, Proposition 3.9(ii)). "best ARI=1": configurations in which the best partitions of relax and lloyd+relax coincide.
